title: Alliteration, Consonance, and Assonance
skills: identify repeated consonant and vowel sound patterns
analyze how sound devices influence rhythm and emphasis
explain how sound patterns contribute to tone and poetic effect
alignment_note: Explains and compares alliteration, consonance, and assonance as sound devices used in poetry and prose. Supports sound-pattern recognition, poetry analysis, interpretation of rhythm and emphasis, and analysis of author's craft across high school English courses.
